sourceLabel: Savius Admin · complete read-only active-account capture
notes: Complete read-only active-account capture: 573 unique accounts across 12 pages; observed sequentially from 2026-10-08T07:06:38.120Z to 2026-10-08T07:07:32.174Z.

Profit-target progress uses the displayed account profit and the owner-defined benchmark: Tomcat 150K = USD 7,500; Thunderbolt 300K = USD 15,000. This is a monitoring benchmark, including Second Cycle products, and does not assert payout eligibility.
Progress bands use unrounded values: green below 80%; orange 80% to below 86%; red 86% or above. Unknowns remain in the account denominator.
Customer identities were read during this collection. Source updated times are preserved as displayed without assigning an unverified timezone.
Scope includes only Instant Funded Tomcat 150K and Thunderbolt 300K, including their Second Cycle variants. Other products do not contribute to the 3/4/5 same-size group qualification.

Failed counts are distinct accounts explicitly classified Drawdown/Failed/Breached; other inactive reasons are not inferred as failures. Payout counts are distinct customer accounts with at least one Completed payout in the fully captured register.
